title: Carry It Over
summary: Una Saltmarsh wants 2 sacks of salt carried from the far end of Hollowmere to Milo Ledger at the reed landing before the weather breaks.
offer_text: "The sacks of salt are by my door and Milo Ledger is waiting at the reed landing. It is a long walk and I have a bad knee. Take them over before the weather breaks."

objectives.text: Take 2 sacks of salt from outside Una's door
Hand the sacks of salt to Milo Ledger
